task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the handheld scanner with the left arm, grab the square-shaped tea-box with the right arm, and scan the square-shaped tea-box.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架左臂拾取手持扫描仪，右臂抓取方形茶盒，扫描​​方形茶盒。
